invented.quote: Our other five branches are not changing.
invented.why: The brief states that two of the seven branches are closing, but it does not say that the remaining five branches are not changing.

invented.quote: In the same period, phone and chat contacts across the credit union rose 60%.
invented.why: The brief does not specify that the 60% increase in phone and chat contacts happened over the same three-year period as the drop in branch visits.

invented.quote: Your manager and someone from HR will meet with each of you one-on-one by [date].
invented.why: The brief does not mention any one-on-one meetings with managers and HR.

invented.quote: When members wait 9 minutes on hold, many of them give up and walk into your branch, often frustrated.
invented.why: The brief gives the 9-minute average hold time, but it does not say that waiting callers give up and walk into branches frustrated.
The brief does not state that the credit union has set a specific target wait-time goal or deadline.

invented.quote: I'll report where we stand in an email to all staff on that date, whether we've hit it or not.
invented.why: The brief does not mention a plan for the COO to send a follow-up progress report email to staff.

invented.quote: Many of you at Maple Street and Route 9 have spent years with members who come to you by name.
invented.why: The brief provides no information about the tenure of the staff at those two branches or their relationships with members.
